_note: INTERIM English only, copied from the unapproved P98 spec. Not a Texts stamp, not canon, and not an owner lock. Russian is omitted on purpose. If any of the six strings for a context is missing in the active locale, all three choices keep their existing labels and no response is shown. Resource numbers stay on the live cost line. Cheaper or new negotiation is off.

terms.loan_next.borrow.repay.result.en: You hand over the tokens against the note you signed.

terms.loan_next.borrow.stall.result.en: He takes the cable. It is not the settlement he asked for.

terms.loan_next.borrow.default.result.en: You send him away without payment. The Exchange will hear that answer.

terms.loan_next.decline.repay.result.en: You owe no advance. The collector pockets the demanded goodwill anyway.

terms.loan_next.decline.stall.label.en: Offer cable instead of goodwill tokens

terms.loan_next.decline.stall.result.en: He takes the cable, but the gesture does not satisfy him.

terms.loan_next.decline.default.result.en: You repeat the refusal. You do not pretend a note was signed.

terms.toll_next.pay.sign.result.en: You sign the line he drew from your first payment.

terms.toll_next.pay.route.label.en: Give Fran's route instead of more tokens

terms.toll_next.pay.route.result.en: You give him Fran's route, not the yard's tokens.

terms.toll_next.pay.bar.result.en: The first payment bought no second answer. You bar the gate.

terms.toll_next.goods.sign.label.en: Accept his ledger after the cable payment

terms.toll_next.goods.sign.result.en: The cable becomes the beginning of his account. You sign it.

terms.toll_next.goods.route.label.en: Name Fran's route instead of paying again

terms.toll_next.goods.route.result.en: You answer the new demand with Fran's route.

terms.toll_next.goods.bar.result.en: You gave him cable once. This time you bar the gate.

terms.toll_next.detour.sign.label.en: Sign now that he knows the detour

terms.toll_next.detour.sign.result.en: He found the long way. You sign the ledger he brought.

terms.toll_next.detour.route.label.en: Give Fran's route, not another detour

terms.toll_next.detour.route.result.en: You name Fran's route rather than promise another way around.

terms.toll_next.detour.bar.label.en: Keep the gate barred despite the patrol

terms.toll_next.detour.bar.result.en: He knows where the handcars went. You still bar the gate.

terms.knock_next.answer.feed.label.en: Feed the woman who answered the knocking

terms.knock_next.answer.feed.result.en: You bring food and write down what she chooses to tell.

terms.knock_next.answer.chapel.label.en: Send the woman you answered to the chapel

terms.knock_next.answer.chapel.result.en: The answer ends in a direction to the chapel, not a bunk here.

terms.knock_next.answer.back.label.en: Turn her back after answering her

terms.knock_next.answer.back.result.en: You answered the knocking. Now you send her back and close the gap.

terms.knock_next.cut.feed.label.en: Feed the woman your cut reached

terms.knock_next.cut.feed.result.en: The cut reached her. You bring food and record her account.

terms.knock_next.cut.chapel.label.en: Send the woman you reached to the chapel

terms.knock_next.cut.chapel.result.en: You reached her through the rock, then direct her to the chapel.

terms.knock_next.cut.back.label.en: Close the way you cut toward her

terms.knock_next.cut.back.result.en: You close the way your crew opened and send her back.

terms.knock_next.fill.feed.label.en: Feed the woman who dug through the fill

terms.knock_next.fill.feed.result.en: She came through despite the fill. You bring food and write her account.

terms.knock_next.fill.chapel.label.en: Send her to the chapel after the failed fill

terms.knock_next.fill.chapel.result.en: The fill did not keep her out. You direct her to the chapel.

terms.knock_next.fill.back.label.en: Send her back and close the gap again

terms.knock_next.fill.back.result.en: You close the gap again. This is another refusal, not a new rescue.
